caseName: City of Hillsboro v. Public Service Commission
caseNameFull: City of Hillsboro, Oregon v. Public Service Commission of Oregon, etc.
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Oregon.
attorneys: Mr. Martin L. Pipes for plaintiff in error. Mr. Charles A. Hart for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction on authority of: (1) Section 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6,1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726. (2) Union Dry Goods Co. v. Georgia Public Service Corporation, 248 U. S. 372. (3) Hunter v. Pittsburgh, 207 U. S. 161, 178; Pawhuska v. Pawhuska Oil Co., 250 U. S. 394, 397.
